gallery.title: File:Zentralbibliothek Solothurn - Abbildungen zur Länder u Völkerkunde - a0486.tif
gallery.description: The sheet contains eight humorous illustrations based on puns related to cities or regions. The figure in the middle shows, for example, a "Solothurner" (person from Solothurn) as a pun on "solo turnen" (doing solo gymnastics) ; another illustration demonstrates how a "Mastrichter" (person from Maastricht) is straightening ("richten" in German) a ship's mast. The titles of the pictures:ein Halberstädter, ein Mastrichter, ein Ollmützer, ein Solothurner, ein Pr. Hammer, ein Uträgter. (The last figure does not have a title or it is lacking, since the lower-right corner of the sheet is torn off).
